mapper.insert: insert into employment_contract( contract_no, employee_no, wage_type, base_wage, daily_work_hours, weekly_work_hours, break_minutes, contract_start, contract_end, payday, contract_status, contract_content ) values( #{contractNo}, #{employeeNo}, #{wageType}, #{baseWage}, #{dailyWorkHours}, #{weeklyWorkHours}, #{breakMinutes}, #{contractStart}, #{contractEnd}, #{payday}, #{contractStatus}, #{contractContent} )
mapper.select: select * from employment_contract where employee_no = #{employeeNo} and contract_status = 'active' and contract_start <= systimestamp and ( contract_end is null or contract_end >= systimestamp ) order by contract_start desc

select * from employment_contract where employee_no = #{employeeNo} and contract_status = 'ended' and contract_end is not null and contract_end <= systimestamp and contract_start <= systimestamp order by contract_start desc

select contract_no, wage_type, base_wage from employment_contract where contract_no = #{contractNo}
select contract_no, daily_work_hours, weekly_work_hours from employment_contract where contract_no = #{contractNo}
select contract_no, contract_start, contract_end, contract_status from employment_contract where contract_no = #{contractNo}
